{{Top|leg}}
The '''Corellian lottery''' was a game of chance that originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. A person would choose four digits out of a select group of numbers, then a [[Standard week/Legends|weekly]] drawing would occur. If the chosen numbers were also the ones drawn, then the person would win a prize.<ref name="IC">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Corellian lottery is almost certainly meant to be a similar to the real&ndash;world [[Wikipedia:Lottery|lottery]].
